name: board-pack
title: Strategy board pack: DRAFT
for_each: select id,code from plans order by code

sections.title: Objectives
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,due_on,status from objectives where plan_id=$1 order by code

sections.title: Scorecard
sections.sql: select s.* from strategy_scorecard s join objectives o on o.code=s.objective where o.plan_id=$1 order by s.code

sections.title: Initiatives
sections.sql: select s.* from strategy_portfolio s join objectives o on o.code=s.objective where o.plan_id=$1 order by s.code

name: decision-record
title: Decision record: DRAFT
for_each: select id,code from decisions order by code

sections.title: Follow-through
sections.sql: select code,title,owner,due_on,status,completed_on,evidence from actions where decision_id=$1 order by code

name: initiative-brief
title: Initiative brief: DRAFT
for_each: select id,code from initiatives order by code

sections.title: Prerequisites
sections.sql: select r.code,r.title,r.status,r.due_on from dependencies d join initiatives r on r.id=d.requires_id where d.initiative_id=$1 order by r.code
